name: Souls Survivors
detailed_description:
The last worlds are crumbling. The last heroes rise.
In Souls Survivors, every step is a battle for survival in a dying universe.

Immerse yourself in a dynamic action roguelite where chaos devours all life. Carve through relentless hordes, face ancient terrors, and uncover the secrets of a world fading before your eyes.

Craft deadly builds, master devastating skills, and explore fallen civilizations in search of the power to save existence.

Game Features:

  • Endless battles
    Fight thousands of enemies — from fallen knights and demonic beasts to cybernetic horrors of lost worlds. Each run brings a new challenge.

  • Epic boss fights
    Face powerful lords awakened from ancient slumber. Each victory brings new rewards: claim their powers and turn enemies into weapons.

  • Diverse locations with unique mechanics
    From abandoned ruins and cursed forests to floating cities and hidden labyrinths — each region offers its own trials: traps, dynamic events, environmental hazards, and secrets that can bless or curse you.

  • Unlimited build possibilities
    Unlock hundreds of skills, combine them with hero traits, discover deadly synergies, and create a new playstyle in every run.

  • Heroes of many realities
    Unlock new characters and their alternate versions from shattered dimensions. Each has their own combat style, unique skills, and growth.

  • World of fallen civilizations
    Explore the remains of worlds, uncover legendary artifacts, learn forgotten stories, and collect fragments of the past to discover who caused the universe’s downfall.

  • Survivor challenges
    Take on special trials and difficulty modes. Survive them to prove your strength and leave your mark in dying worlds.

Souls Survivors is a game where every run is a new chance to save the world — or die with it.
In a world racing toward destruction, only your decisions, skills, and courage will decide the outcome.

Will you endure the final battle for the universe? Or vanish with its final breath?

About Us

We are a small team of a few people, creating games we would love to play ourselves.

We’d like to sincerely thank each of you for your interest and involvement. We deeply appreciate your support — it means the world to us!

If you're interested in our game, adding it to your wishlist would be a huge help!
